Handler: for an action caption it asks vision to TRANSCRIBE the image verbatim (not solve), then runs the caption + extracted content through runAgentFn so calculate/convert_units/convert_currency/translate do the work; sends a resulting photo too; persists the turn. 7 new tests (4 photo-intent + updated/added 3 handler: describe stays one-shot, action extracts+agents+chains). suite 1603 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline handler + lib tests, mock vision+agent).

Audit immediately caught photo-to-action DEAD IN PRODUCTION: the branch gated on deps.runAgentFn, but index.ts wires describeImage and NOT runAgentFn (a test-only override), so every action-caption photo silently fell to the one-shot vision describe (the exact bug the feature fixes). Fixed before push: gate/call on runIt (= deps.runAgentFn ?? runAgent, already defined) so it fires in prod. Also, same iteration: (a) media tail-trim — photo/document answers used formatReply (hard 1200-char cut, no 'more' recovery); switched to formatReplyParts + lastResult drilldown like the text path; (b) OCR-trust — the agent task now tells it to echo the figures it read from the photo + flag they came from an image, so a vision misread is visible instead of an authoritative wrong total. Suite 1603 green, tsc clean.

Added timers — the most common assistant errand that silently fell through. parseSchedule handled 'in N min' + 'alarm at HH' but not the 'timer'/'for N minutes' form, so 'set a timer for 20 minutes' dropped to the agent (no timer tool) -> confused reply. New timer parse branch (before relative): 'set/start a timer for N min', 'timer N min', 'N minute timer', worded ('half an hour', 'a couple hours'), min/hour/sec units (sec rounds up to 1 min floor). It's a once + reminderOnly schedule that pings 'timer's up ⏰' after the duration; a labeled purpose ('for the pasta') is kept as the note. Wired: schedule cue includes 'timer' + HELP line. 3 new tests (parse forms + handler routing), suite 1605 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline parse + handler).

A reminder with no time no longer loses the task. 'remind me to call mom' failed parseSchedule (no time clause); the handler already ASKED 'when?' but discarded the task, so the reply 'at 3pm' had no 'call mom' and either mis-scheduled or dropped. Added a pendingReminder stash (mirrors pendingLocation): the ask-branch strips 'remind me to' + a dangling vague-time word and stashes the bare to-do; the next message, if it looks like a time (at/in/tomorrow/tonight/HH[:MM][am/pm]), recombines 'remind me to <task> <time>' + re-runs scheduleAdd; a non-time reply abandons the pending state + routes normally (never trapped); an unparseable time re-asks once. 4 new tests (resume schedules stashed task; non-time reply drops+routes to agent; + the existing ask tests still green), suite 1607 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline handler).

Added watch-any-page: 'watch terms: https://site/terms' pings when THAT page's content changes — restocks, price drops with no fixed number, policy/status/appointment pages the numeric/feed watches can't cover. New src/lib/pagediff.ts: pageText (strip tags/scripts/styles + collapse to comparable lines), pageKey (case/whitespace-insensitive), diffPages (order-independent added/removed line sets), formatPageDiff (a 'what changed' summary), pageWatchUrl (a bare-URL task). Alert gains pageUrl; parseAlertCommand detects a bare-URL task (before feed/threshold); alert-runner has a page branch: fetch DIRECTLY (new fetchPage dep = SSRF-guarded defaultFetchText), seed silently on first check, notify with the diff on a real change, stay silent on unchanged / whitespace-drift / a failed fetch (never a false change), baseline advance deferred to post-send commit. Auto-scheduled on the alert cadence like any watch; handler confirms 'watching that page... I'll message you with what changed'. 16 new tests (pagediff lib + parse + runner seed/change/unchanged/fetch-fail); live-probed example.com through pageText (200, clean extract) so call-tested:true for the fetch+extract, agent-free runner offline-tested. suite 1619 green, tsc clean.

Relay can now READ a QR from a sent photo (symmetric with make_qr). Send a photo + 'scan this QR' -> the payload is decoded by a keyless reader instead of the vision describe (which can't reliably read it). New src/lib/qr-decode.ts: parseQrRead (pull the payload from the api.qrserver.com read-endpoint JSON) + readQrFromBytes (injected multipart POST, null on no-code/failure). photo-intent gains photoIsQrScan (scan/read/decode + qr/barcode). Handler photo branch: a QR-scan caption calls readQr FIRST (before photo-to-action/describe), frames a URL payload as a link + other payloads as text, or says 'couldn't find a QR' + falls back. index wires readQr (download + multipart POST to the fixed qrserver host — no SSRF surface since no user URL). 8 new tests (lib parse/decode + intent + 2 handler routes); live-probed the qrserver read endpoint with real QR bytes (200, exact payload decoded) so call-tested:true for the decoder, handler offline-tested. suite 1627 green, tsc clean.

Fixed 2 coupled regressions in the just-shipped watch-any-page. (1) SNAPSHOT CAP: the page snapshot was stored as lastValue with NO cap (unlike MAX_SERIES_POINTS/MAX_SEEN_KEYS) — a big page (long terms/search-results, hundreds of KB) inflated every atomic rewrite of the shared alerts file + could fail all persists. pageText now caps extracted text at 16KB. (2) FLAP FIREHOSE: a dynamic page (nonce/CSRF/timestamp/'N min ago') diffed as a change EVERY fetch, and alerts are exempt from the anti-spam cap + quiet-hours -> a 3am firehose. Two-layer fix: pageKey now compares stableText (masks long hex tokens, ISO timestamps, clock times, 'N ago', long digit runs) so a volatile-only re-render is NOT a change; plus a consecutive-change flap counter (bumpFlap/resetFlap) that auto-mutes the watch after PAGE_FLAP_CAP=3 straight real changes (pauses its schedule + sends ONE heads-up: 'that page looks dynamic, paused it, resume <name>'). 5 new tests (cap, token-mask, real-change-still-differs, flap auto-mute), .env.example RELAY_PAGE_FLAP_CAP added, suite 1630 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline lib + runner).

Seconds timers are honored exactly now. 'timer for 20 seconds' rounded UP to 60s (Math.max(MINUTE, round(n/60)*MINUTE)) — a materially wrong duration confirmed as correct; '90 seconds' fired at 120s. Now sec -> n*1000 (dueMs = now + exact seconds); the timer fires on the next scheduler tick after it's due (<= the ~30s tick interval late), not reshaped. 1 new test (20s/90s/30s honored exactly), suite 1631 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline parse).

Added a keyless get_fun tool: 'tell me a joke' / 'fun fact' / 'quiz me' — among the most common FIRST messages to a new bot — now answer instantly instead of a slow browse or a stale from-memory reply. New src/lib/fun.ts: parseFunKind (joke default / fact / trivia), funUrl (official-joke-api / catfact.ninja / opentdb — all keyless no-signup), formatFun (joke=setup+punchline, fact, trivia=question+answer w/ HTML-entity decode). Wired like get_news: TOOLS[] entry + BrowserBackend.getFun + defaultBackend (funFetch+defaultFetchText) + dispatch + prompt line + sorted tool-list test + START ('tell me a joke') + HELP. 8 new tests; live-probed all 3 sources (joke 200, catfact 200, opentdb 200) so call-tested:true for the sources, agent wiring offline-tested. suite 1639 green, tsc clean.

Fixed looksLikeErrorReply over-reach that silently killed real watches. ERROR_REPLY_RE ended with bare  error  + lone words (cannot/blocked/failed/unable/no results), which occur constantly in legitimate content — so a news/HN/value watch on 'Why you cannot trust AI benchmarks' / 'Tesla recall blocked by court' / 'No results for the Lakers' was treated as a fetch failure, held at the old baseline, and went DARK on that change forever (regression from my earlier error-reply-false-fires fix). Rewrote the regex ANCHORED to real failure phrasing: (a) explicit HTTP error+code either order ('error 404', 'returned a 503', '404 error'), (b) first-person fetch failure 'couldn't/can't/unable to/failed to <fetch-verb>' (load/fetch/reach/get/retrieve/find/connect/access/read/open/pull/lookup/...), (c) standalone idioms ('try again later', 'access denied', 'the server is down', 'no data available', 'request timed out'). Legit headlines with cannot/blocked/error mid-sentence no longer flagged; genuine soft failures still are. 9 new assertions (false-positive guards + real-failure cases), suite 1639 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (pure regex + existing runner/digest tests).

Fixed 2 coupled regressions in watch-any-page. (1) TRAILING PUNCT: pageWatchUrl captured https?://S+ up to whitespace, so a URL ending a sentence ('...policy.') kept the trailing period -> every fetch 404'd -> the watch was a silent black hole ('Watching...' but never pings). Now trims trailing sentence punctuation + a stray unbalanced close-paren (mirrors last-result.extractLinks); a balanced '(bar)' in a Wikipedia URL is kept. (2) TIME MASK: stableText masked ALL clock times to stop 'last updated' flap, but that erased CONTENT-bearing times, so an appointment/departure page ('Next available 3:15pm'->'5:45pm', 'Departs 9:00'->'10:30') never pinged on exactly the change it's watched for. Now a clock time is masked ONLY when adjacent to a volatile lead-in (last updated / as of / refreshed / now); a bare content time is kept + diffed. 6 new assertions (trailing-punct incl. balanced paren + content-time-detected + last-updated-still-masked), suite 1641 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (pure lib).

'pollen today' / 'allergies' matched the air-quality intent but pollen was never fetched — the Open-Meteo query only requested AQI/PM/UV, so an allergy sufferer got AQI+UV + zero pollen. Now airQualityUrl requests grass/birch/alder/ragweed_pollen; parseAirQuality collects the numeric ones (Europe-only — null elsewhere -> pollenCovered stays false); formatAirQuality gained a lead mode ('pollen'|'uv'|'aqi') + a pollen line (peak level via new pollenRisk bands + which allergen is highest), and OUTSIDE Europe says 'I don't have pollen data for X (Europe only)' instead of implying none. Dispatch: a pollen/allergy ask leads with pollen, a sunscreen ask with UV, else AQI. isAirRequest also matches allergy/hayfever. Tool desc + prompt note pollen (Europe only). 7 new tests; live-probed Open-Meteo (Berlin returns pollen numbers, Austin null) so call-tested:true for the source, agent wiring offline-tested. suite 1645 green, tsc clean.

Fixed AlertStore.add overwrite branch leaving stale pageUrl/series/flapCount on a re-define. Root cause: it mutated a hand-picked field subset and never touched pageUrl/series/flapCount. So (a) re-defining a name AS a page-watch stored task=URL but pageUrl=undefined -> ran the LLM on a bare URL instead of page-diffing (confirmation said 'watching that page', did otherwise); (b) re-pointing a former page-watch to a value task kept the stale pageUrl -> diffed the OLD page forever; (c) 'watch price: bitcoin'->'silver' kept the old BTC series -> chart/trend showed a phantom crash. Now existing.pageUrl is synced from the command (undefined clears it), a pageUrl change counts as a trigger change, and a trigger change resets lastValue + series + flapCount so a re-pointed watch starts fresh. 2 new tests (page-watch set/clear round-trip; series dropped on re-point), suite 1647 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline store).

Verified + closed the gap. The core 'every weekday at N' cadence ALREADY worked (parseSchedule maps weekday/weekdays -> weekly [1,2,3,4,5] with the right hour + reminderOnly — audit finding was mostly stale). Real gap: the synonyms 'workday'/'workdays'/'business day(s)' returned NULL. Fixed by normalizing them to 'weekday(s)' on the raw text at the top of parseSchedule (before parsing, so cleanTask still strips the clause), so 'every workday at 8' / 'every business day at 9' now -> weekly Mon-Fri. 'weekend(s)' already parsed. 2 new assertions (workday + business day synonyms), suite 1648 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline parse).

'do I need sunscreen' now answers from TODAY'S PEAK UV, not the instant reading. formatAirQuality printed the current uv_index with no time qualifier, so an 8am UV of 2 (low) said 'you're fine' even when midday peaks at 9 — a confidently misleading whole-day call; at night it read 0. Added daily=uv_index_max&forecast_days=1 to the SAME keyless air-quality call (no extra request), parse -> uvMax, and formatAirQuality now leads UV off the peak ('UV peaks at 9 today (very high — wear sunscreen midday), 2 right now') with the current value as context; falls back to the instant reading labeled 'right now' when no daily peak. 4 new/updated tests (peak leads not instant; low-peak no nudge; no-daily fallback), suite 1648 green, tsc clean; live-probed Open-Meteo (peak 9.1 vs instant 3.3) so call-tested:true for the source, formatting offline-tested.

Added a keyless unit_price tool: 'which is cheaper, 500g for $4 or 1.2kg for $9' / '$3.99 for 12oz vs $5.49 for 20oz' / '12 for $6 or 30 for $13' now compare price-per-unit + name the winner, instead of the agent hand-normalizing mixed units (the silently-wrong mental math the prompt forbids). New src/lib/unitprice.ts: parseUnitPrice (splits on or/vs/comma; handles '<qty><unit> for $<price>', '$<price> for/per/<qty><unit>', '$<price>/unit'), compareUnitPrice (reuses new units-convert.toBaseAmount to normalize weight/volume/length + a dimensionless 'count' dim; rejects mixed dimensions), formatUnitPrice (per-100g/100ml/m/each + a % cheaper). Wired like convert_units (pure, no backend): TOOLS[] + dispatch + prompt + sorted tool-list test + HELP. 9 new tests, suite 1657 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (pure lib + dispatch).

'remind me to check on mom at 8pm' now echoes, not browses. FETCH_CUE_RE (which flags a reminder as needing the agent at fire time) still listed 'check on'/'check the', so caretaking to-dos ('check on mom', 'check on the baby', 'check the oven/mail') were routed to a confused 20-40s browser run/refusal instead of a plain reminder echo. Removed both cues — the real lookup targets (weather/the price/the score/the news/the status/standings/look up/search/summar...) are listed explicitly, so 'check the weather'/'check the price of bitcoin'/'check the news' STILL match via the data noun + stay on the agent path. 8 new assertions (check-on/check-the household to-dos are reminderOnly; check-the-weather/price/news still agent). suite 1658 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline parse).

Fixed a reminder grabbing an HH:MM from the TASK body + firing at the wrong hour. The 24-hour (at24) branch ran before am/pm and its 'at' was OPTIONAL, so 'remind me at 9am to submit the 10:30 report' matched the bare '10:30' in the note -> fired 10:30 instead of the explicit 9am. Anchored the colon-time regex to require 'at' or 'tomorrow' immediately before it; a bare time inside the task body is now ignored, and 'at 9am' (no colon) falls through to the am/pm branch -> fires 09:00. 'at 14:30'/'tomorrow at 09:00'/'tomorrow 9:30' still parse. 2 new tests (explicit am/pm wins over body 10:30; a body HH:MM under 'in 20 min' isn't hijacked), suite 1660 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline parse).

Fixed unit_price breaking on a thousands-separated number. parseUnitPrice split on the ',' option separator BEFORE per-option comma-stripping, so '$1,299 for 3 vs $1,499 for 4' split into '$1'/'299 for 3' -> unparseable -> null -> the model fell back to mental math (the silently-wrong arithmetic the tool exists to prevent). Now strips in-number thousands commas (a comma between a digit and exactly-3-more-digits, via lookbehind/lookahead — the (?:D|$) tail so '1,200g' works too) BEFORE the separator split. 2 new assertions ('$1,299 for 3 vs $1,499 for 4' compares; comma in the qty too), suite 1661 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (pure parse).

Fixed a watch reading '1.2M subscribers' as 1.2 (off by 6 orders). extractValue's untagged branch excludes a bare m/t (to avoid '3m ago'/'5t'), and a NON-currency count has no $ tag, so '1.2M subscribers' collapsed to 1.2 -> a 'below 50000'/'above 2000000' predicate fired/never-fired + the series recorded garbage. Added a count-magnitude scan (before the general untagged branch): a k/m/b/t/mn/bn suffix IS scaled when immediately followed by a COUNT NOUN (subscribers/followers/views/downloads/users/stars/tokens/streams/members/... — never a time word), so '1.2M subscribers'->1200000, '5B views'->5e9, '5T tokens'->5e12, while '3m ago' stays 3. Hint-nearest applies for multi-number replies. 8 new assertions (count-magnitude scaling + 3m-ago regression + below/above predicate correctness), suite 1662 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (pure extractValue).

Fixed extractValue over-scaling a plain count by 1000-1e9. The untagged magnitude scan had the suffix (k|bn|b|thousand|...) with NO trailing boundary, so a bare k/b glued to a WORD matched: 'only 4 boxes left'->4e9 (the 'b'), '3 km'->3000, '2 kg'->2000, '3 bedrooms'->3e9 — false-firing 'below/above' predicates + logging phantom multi-billion chart points across count/inventory/rental watches. (Bare m/t were already excluded; k/b were the leftover gap.) Added a (?![a-z]) boundary to the suffix group so a letter-glued k/b does NOT scale, while a true token-end magnitude ('$60k','1.3bn') + the count-noun path ('900k downloads') still do. 8 new assertions (boxes/km/kg/bedrooms not scaled; $60k/900k downloads/1.3bn still scaled; below-10 inventory predicate correct), suite 1663 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (pure extractValue).

A timer / short 'in N min' reminder no longer gets deferred hours by quiet-hours. The runner only exempted a wall-clock 'once' (clockTime) from the quiet defer, so 'timer for 20 minutes' at 11pm (or 'remind me in 30 min') was pushed to the window end (e.g. 7am) — the most common errand silently broken by hours (latent: gated on RELAY_QUIET_START/END being set). Added a SHORT-HORIZON exemption: a once with no clockTime whose dueMs-created <= 3h is a deliberate near-term instant (timer / 'in a couple hours') and fires on time; a LONG relative once ('in 2 days', incidental late-night instant) still defers. 2 new runner tests (short once fires in quiet hours; long relative once still defers) + updated 2 existing quiet-defer tests to use a long-horizon once. suite 1664 green, tsc clean. call-tested:false (offline runner, injected clock+quietUntil).

Added weather-conditional alerts — the flagship proactive errand. 'watch umbrella: if it rains tomorrow' / 'watch cold: if it's below freezing tonight' / 'watch heat: if it gets above 95 today' now check the keyless Open-Meteo forecast on the alert cadence and ping ONCE (edge-triggered) when it's going to happen. New src/lib/weather-alert.ts: parseWeatherCondition (rain/snow/below/above/wind + today|tomorrow + 'in <place>'; 'below freezing'->32F), evalWeatherCondition (rain/snow via WMO code or precip>=50%, below/above vs the day's lo/hi in the threshold's units, wind via current windKph proxy; missing day -> hold), describeWeatherCondition. Wired: Alert.weather field + parseAlertCommand branch (gated on a weather/temp cue so a plain 'below 50000' stays a numeric watch) + AlertStore.add/overwrite persist+reset + alert-runner branch (edge-triggered via lastValue '1'/'0', holds on fetch fail) + index fetchWeather dep (named place or saved home coords) + alertDefine return + handler confirm + HELP. 20 new tests; live-probed Open-Meteo forecast (200, daily code/precip/hi/lo present) so call-tested:true for the source, runner+parse offline-tested. suite 1674 green, tsc clean.

Wired Telegram inline keyboards end-to-end so proactive pings are one-tap, not text dead-ends. New src/lib/callbacks.ts: encode/decodeCallback (2-char opcode + name, omits a button rather than truncate past Telegram's 64-byte cap) + alert/digest/recipe keyboard builders + buttonsForTask (maps an alert:/digest:/recipe:<name> schedule marker to its keyboard). telegram.ts: parseUpdates now maps a callback_query to a callback InboundMessage (chatId from the attached message, advances offset even when skipped), sendMessage takes an optional inline keyboard (attached to the last chunk only), + answerCallback acks the tap. channel.ts threads keyboard + answerCallback (console ignores them). schedule-runner attaches buttonsForTask(s.task) to every alert/digest/recipe ping (plain reminders get none). handler routes a callback FIRST: rate-limited, acked, decoded -> alert Refresh (re-check now via alertRunNow, send result+buttons, commit), Snooze (pause 1 day), Stop (forget the watch), digest/recipe Run again (recipeRunByName mirrors the scheduler chain/slot path). index wires answerCallback + recipeRunByName. HELP + 19 new tests (codec/builders, callback routing, parseUpdates callback, runner button pass-through). suite 1693 green, tsc clean. Offline-tested (no new data source); anvil-independent.

One-tap pick buttons on numbered/bulleted answers (inline-result-picker). New src/lib/result-list.ts: parseResultList detects a genuine 2+ item numbered (ascending from 1, stops at a gap) or bulleted list in a reply — conservative so prose with an incidental '1.' or 'the answer is 42' never sprouts buttons; firstUrl pulls an item's link. Extended callbacks.ts with a 'pick' op (opcode pk|<index>, index-carrying not name, rejects non-integer/negative) + pickButtons(count) building a capped '1 2 3…' row. handler: a clean non-degraded text reply that's a list caches its items per-chat + attaches the pick row; a pick tap resends '<n>. <item>' with a 🔗 link line when the URL is mid-text (deduped when it already trails). Stale/out-of-range/no-cached-list taps give an honest 'not available' note. HELP updated. 14 new tests (parser incl. no-false-fire/gap-stop/start-at-1, pick codec cap+reject, handler list-attaches-buttons + pick-resend + link + stale). suite 1707 green, tsc clean. Offline (no data source); anvil-independent.

Extended the one-tap result picker to PROACTIVE list pings (picker-on-proactive-pings). Made the handler's pick-list cache injectable (pickListStore dep) + shared it with the schedule-runner via index; the runner now parseResultList's each proactive sendText and, on a 2+ item numbered/bulleted ping (a watchlist restock, a feed of new listings), caches the items + appends a '1 2 3…' pick row BELOW any Refresh/Stop marker row — so a tap resends that item via the same handler pick routing built earlier. A tap resolves against whichever list the chat last saw, inbound answer or unprompted ping. 2 new runner tests (numbered ping attaches+caches; pick row merges below an alert's Refresh/Stop). suite 1709 green, tsc clean. Offline (no data source); anvil-independent.

Onboarding tap-to-try (onboarding-tap-to-try): the first /start (or greeting) reply now carries a row of one-tap example buttons (☀️ Weather, 📖 Define a word, 💸 Tip split, 🎲 Flip a coin) so a brand-new user gets an instant first success instead of reading the START wall + hand-typing. New TRY_EXAMPLES list (keyless/instant errands only, no anvil dependency so the first tap can't dead-end on a down browser) + tryButtons() (2 per row) + a 'try' callback op (ty|<index>) in callbacks.ts. Handler attaches the buttons ONLY on the START reply (opens with the wave), on a channel with callbacks, and on FIRST contact (empty history) so a returning user's /start isn't re-badged; a try tap runs the canned text through handleOne exactly as if typed (command/agent routing). 7 new tests (try codec cap+reject, buttons shape, first-start attaches, returning-user no-buttons, tap runs example). suite 1714 green, tsc clean. Offline (no data source); anvil-independent (examples are keyless).

Hedged MemoryStore write failures (memory-write-silent-fail) — the one store that ignored its disk-write result. memory-store.ts persist() now records atomicWriteJson's boolean into lastWriteOk + exposes lastSaveOk() (matching schedule/alert/recipe/profile/lists). Wired a memorySaveOk dep through index -> handler; after the main-path memorySet, if the write didn't reach disk the handler warns the user ONCE per chat ('couldn't save our conversation... may forget recent context if I restart; reminders/watches unaffected') so a full/unwritable disk isn't invisible. 4 new tests (store lastSaveOk true on good write + false when a parent path is a file so mkdir fails; handler warns once not per-turn; silent when clean). suite 1717 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Fixed a noisy watch silently dropping the user's daily briefing (chatty-watch-starves-daily). An alert check is cap-EXEMPT but still burns the per-chat hourly send budget via noteSend; the old code then DROPPED a plain daily/weekly/scheduled-recipe occurrence over-cap (only once/monthly/yearly/digest got the defer-then-force grace), so one chatty watch could no-show the relied-upon 'every morning: weather + news' for the day with only a log line. Extended graceEligible in schedule-runner to daily, weekly, and recipe: markers — they're user-assembled CONTENT, deferred to a free slot then forced past the grace window rather than lost. interval stays droppable (a sticky 'nag me every 15 min' IS the storm case the cap exists to throttle). Rewrote 2 tests to the new deferred-then-forced daily contract + added a chatty-alert-starves-daily regression + an interval-still-drops test. suite 1718 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Quiet hours no longer let a persistent watch buzz at 3am (quiet-hours-persistent-alerts). The blanket alert-exemption from the quiet-hours defer was too broad: it exists so an EDGE-triggered crossing (value/predicate/weather 'below 50k' that can revert overnight) is still evaluated on cadence — but it also let a PERSISTENT alert (a new feed item, a page-diff, still there at quiet-end) wake the user at 3am for no reason. Added an alertQuietDeferrable(chatId,name) classifier dep; index returns true for feed/feedSource/pageUrl watches (persistent) and false for value/predicate/weather/watchlist (edge). The runner now defers a persistent alert to quiet-end like any schedule (nothing lost, no 3am buzz) while keeping edge-triggered alerts exempt (checked on cadence so a reverting crossing isn't missed). Unknown/absent -> edge default (keep exempt, prior behavior). 2 new tests (persistent defers to quiet-end then sends; edge stays exempt even with a classifier wired); existing edge-exempt + non-alert-defers guards unchanged. suite 1720 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Sports is no longer today-only (sports-next-game): 'when do the Lakers play next', 'next Arsenal game', 'upcoming NFL' now return the next scheduled fixture. Live-probed the keyless ESPN cdn scoreboard — it accepts a dates=YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD range that returns scheduled 'pre' games with ISO kickoff dates. scores.ts: added date to GameScore + parse it (event.date/competition.date), wantsNextGame() intent detector, nextGameUrl() (forward now-1d..now+45d range), pickNextGame() (soonest not-final game >= now-3h), getNextGame() (resolve league -> fetch range -> team-filter with the same not-playing guard so another team's game isn't returned -> soonest), formatNextGame(). agent.ts get_scores dispatch: a 'next'/'upcoming'/'when do they play' request routes to getNextGame(nowMs); AND a team with no game today now auto-looks-up its next game instead of dead-ending. get_scores tool desc + prompt menu updated; new getNextGame backend method + defaultBackend wiring (no new TOOLS entry, so pinned-tool tests unaffected). 8 new tests (intent detect, url range, pick soonest/none, getNextGame team-filter + none + unresolvable, format). suite 1728 green, tsc clean. Live-probed data source (ESPN range 200, scheduled games present) so call-tested:true for the source; runner/agent path offline-tested.

Fixed a bare 'ok'/'got it'/'stop' silently deleting an active sticky nag (sticky-ack-only-when-recent). hasSticky gated a bare ack but ignored whether a sticky recently PINGED, so an unrelated 'ok' hours after the meds/water nag last fired wiped the safety-net reminder. Added ScheduleStore.hasRecentlyFiredSticky(chatId,now,windowMs) — true only when a sticky pinged within the window (user plausibly replying to it) or hasn't fired yet (ack about the setup); index's stickyAck now gates on it (RELAY_STICKY_ACK_WINDOW_MS, default 90m) so a bare ack outside the window routes as a normal message. .env.example parity added. 1 new store test (not-yet-fired counts, 30m-ago counts, 3h-ago doesn't, hasSticky still true). suite 1729 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

One-tap 'make this recurring' buttons on fresh answers (tap-to-watch-on-answers) — the retention flywheel the text save-nudge only described. A clean inbound text answer that's a plausible standing errand now gets 🔁 Every morning (+ 🔔 Watch this for a price/number answer). Added an 'act' callback op (bare opcodes ad/aw, no payload — the task is resolved from a per-chat lastTask cache) + actButtons(offerWatch) in callbacks.ts; handler caches the answer's task, gates the offer via canOfferAutomation (skips command/automation/follow-up/trivial messages) + answerIsWatchable (money or a price-ask returning a number), and on tap synthesizes 'every morning <task>' or 'watch <slug>: <task> when it changes' (watchSlug derives a short name) and runs it through handleOne — same schedule/alert routing, no new backend, every existing guard applies. One-shot (consumes the cached task so a double-tap can't stack two). Stale tap -> honest note. Pick-list answers keep their 1/2/3 buttons (act only when not a list). HELP updated. 6 new tests (act codec + buttons, gating helpers, answer-attaches + Every-morning schedules + Watch-this defines + stale). suite 1735 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Fixed a relative 'remind me in N hours' set at night silently firing hours late (relative-once-quiet-defer). The quiet-hours short-once exemption used a 3h window, so 'remind me in 4 hours' at 11pm was deferred to the 7am quiet-end — a deliberate near-term instant silently broken. Raised the window to 18h (env-tunable RELAY_SHORT_ONCE_MS) so ANY same-day 'in N hours' relative once fires on time, while a genuinely long 'in 2 days' once (time-of-day incidental, measured in days) still defers. clockTime alarms already exempt; recurring dailies/digests still defer. .env.example parity added. 1 new test ('in 4 hours' fires in quiet hours); existing long-once-defers + short-timer-fires guards unchanged. suite 1736 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Stopped answering transit asks with a car ETA (transit-honest-not-driving). routeMode silently mapped transit->driving, so 'how long downtown by subway/bus/train' returned an OSRM CAR duration labeled 'drive' — a confidently-wrong answer. directions.ts: added wantsTransit() (subway/metro/bus/train/tram/tube/'by transit'/'public transport', NOT a bare 'how do I get to X') + transitMapsLink() (a Google Maps travelmode=transit link, coords when known else labels). agent.ts directions dispatch: a transit ask (and no explicit driving/walking/cycling mode override) now returns the Maps transit link + an honest 'I can't compute transit times myself' note instead of an OSRM route; offers a driving/walking estimate as fallback. Tool desc updated. 3 new tests (wantsTransit detects/ignores, transitMapsLink coords+labels+My-Location). suite 1739 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent (Maps link, no fetch).

A scheduled digest/recipe no longer goes silently dead when its content is deleted (digest-silent-on-member-delete). Both null-compose branches in schedule-runner (digestRun -> null = all members gone; recipeResolveTask -> null = recipe deleted) used to just complete() + advance, so a relied-upon 'morning briefing' no-showed every day forever with zero explanation. Added a goneNotice dep + noteGone() helper: for a RECURRING schedule (not a once, which just drops) it sends a one-time 'your <name> briefing/recipe stopped — its content was removed, I've turned it off' notice, tracked per schedule id (goneNotified set) so a daily doesn't repeat it, and anti-spam-capped. index's goneNotice also removeByTask's the dead schedule so it stops firing. 2 new tests (recurring recipe+digest each notify once then stay silent across a re-fire; a once stays silent). suite 1741 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Flight status lookup (flight-status): 'is AA100 on time', 'where's UA83', 'when does DL215 land' now answered instead of dead-ending (track_package only knew parcels). New src/lib/flight.ts: detectFlight (2-char airline code incl letter+digit like B6, +1-4 digits, gated on a flight cue OR a bare designator so a stray 'AA100' in prose doesn't trigger); parseAdsbdbRoute (KEYLESS adsbdb -> airline + origin/dest city+IATA); parseAdsbLive (KEYLESS adsb.lol -> airborne now + alt/speed); adsbdbUrl/adsbLiveUrl (ICAO callsign via a common IATA->ICAO map, IATA fallback); formatFlight (honest: route + airborne + tracker link, NEVER an invented gate/delay — no keyless source for scheduled gate/on-time, so it says so + links flightaware); getFlight (both sources, returns null only when route AND live both fail). Wired get_flight tool + dispatch + BrowserBackend.getFlight + defaultBackend + prompt menu + HELP + the pinned tool-name list (now 40 tools). No anvil needed (2 keyless JSON APIs). 15 new tests (detect gate/ignore, both parsers incl 'ground' alt, url ICAO/IATA, honest format no-gate, getFlight route+live/route-only/null, 2 dispatch). suite 1756 green, tsc clean. Live-probed both APIs (adsbdb 200 AA100->JFK/LHR/American; adsb.lol 200) so call-tested:true for the data sources; agent path offline-tested.

Fixed a watch silently dying when its source keeps failing (silent-watch-death). A degraded/error-shaped/empty-fetch read returns notify:false and never throws, so the runner counted it as success (resetFailures) and the failed-watch receipt (thrown-only) never fired — a dead watch looked armed for weeks. Added a softFail flag to AlertRunResult, set at the genuine can't-read holds (degraded reply, caught agent throw, looksLikeErrorReply, empty page fetch, unassessable weather) — distinct from a healthy silent hold (unchanged/condition-not-true/seed). Threaded through index alertCheck -> runner, which now counts a per-watch consecutive soft-fail streak (separate in-memory map) and sends the existing failStreakNotice receipt after FAIL_STREAK_NOTIFY, resetting on any clean read so an intermittent blip never trips it. 5 new tests (checkAlert flags degraded+error-reply softFail, clean hold doesn't; runner fires receipt at streak 3, resets on a clean read mid-streak). suite 1760 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Fixed a background errand double-firing after a crash (bg-errand-double-fire). If the worker crashed in the gap between sending a 'get back to me' result and clearing its persisted record, startup recovery re-ran the whole errand + texted a second (possibly different) unprompted answer. Mirrored the once-schedule delivered flag: added PendingErrand.delivered + BackgroundStore.markDelivered (persists BEFORE remove); the handler calls bgErrandDelivered right BEFORE the success send, so a crash in the send->done gap leaves delivered:true on disk. planErrandReplay now returns {replay:false, notice:null} for a delivered errand (drop the stale record silently — the user already got the real result); index guards the null notice + still removes it. Marking before the send trades a rare skipped-redelivery-on-send-failure for never double-delivering (a duplicate ping is the annoying case). 2 new tests (markDelivered persists across a reload; planErrandReplay drops a delivered errand with no notice). suite 1762 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Fixed an in-stock watch never firing on a normal product page (instock-cross-sell-never-fires). conditionHolds in_stock returned null (hold) whenever a buy CTA AND cross-sell framing ('you may also like') both appeared — which is almost every product page — so an edge-triggered 'alert me when back in stock' was never satisfied and the restock was missed. Now positional: a CTA BEFORE the first cross-sell marker is the watched item's primary above-the-fold buy button -> in stock; a CTA appearing SOLELY inside the recommendations block stays ambiguous (null). Out-of-stock negation + explicit in-stock phrase + no-cross-sell CTA paths unchanged. 1 new test (primary-CTA-before-recs -> true; cross-sell-only CTA -> null); existing cta-scoping/no-framing tests still green. suite 1763 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Saved named places (saved-named-places): the profile stored only ONE location, so 'coffee near work'/'weather at the gym'/'directions to mom's' re-asked the city each time. New src/lib/places-store.ts: PlacesStore (per-chat alias->address, atomic+corrupt-safe, cap 20, re-save updates in place, lastSaveOk hedge) + parseSavePlace ('my work is <addr>', 'save gym: <addr>', 'set home to <addr>', '<name> is at <addr>' — alias <=3 words + place-shaped address so 'my day is great' isn't captured) + parseForgetPlace + isListPlacesRequest. Wired: state-paths (RELAY_PLACES_FILE) + .env.example parity, index constructs it + injects places.contextLine into profileContext (so the LLM substitutes the alias for its address when calling weather/find_nearby/directions) + corrupt-store label + save/forget/list handler deps. Handler routes place-save BEFORE rememberFact (else 'remember my office is X' stored as a raw fact) + before scheduler/agent. HELP line. 11 new tests (parser save/forget/list incl no-false-capture; store save/resolve/overwrite/forget/persist/contextLine/per-chat; handler save+list+forget+precedence-over-remember+fallthrough). suite 1774 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent (aliases resolve via the agent, no new fetch).

Restored the failed-send re-fire guarantee (send-never-throws-dead-commit-guard). telegram sendMessage catches every error + resolved void, so the runner's carefully-built 'advance the alert baseline / complete the schedule ONLY after a successful send' guards were dead code in prod — a 429/network/blocked send committed the baseline anyway (an edge-triggered crossing swallowed forever) + completed a once (a 'take your meds' reminder silently dropped). sendMessage now RETURNS a delivered-boolean (still non-throwing for best-effort inbound replies; false = a chunk failed); the runner gates both the main proactive send (alertCommit + store.complete) and the reminderOnly send on it, throwing into the tick's catch on a false return so a once retries next tick + a recurring advances-and-retries next cadence. A channel returning void/undefined is treated as delivered (only explicit false = failure), so console/older wiring is unchanged. 4 new tests (failed alert send: no commit + re-fires; failed reminder: not completed, retries + delivers; successful send commits+completes). suite 1777 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Quick cited facts (wikipedia-fast-fact): 'who is the CEO of OpenAI', 'how tall is Everest', 'what is a Roth IRA' — the most common first errand — answered instantly instead of a 10-30s web_search->scrape->summarize (often wrong page). New src/lib/wikifact.ts: searchUrl (full-text list=search, ranks by content so 'ceo of openai'->OpenAI, unlike opensearch prefix-match) + parseSearchTitle; summaryUrl + parseSummary (REST summary -> title/description/extract/url; returns null for a disambiguation page so a multi-meaning term isn't answered with one meaning, + clips a long extract at a sentence boundary to phone size); formatFact (title — desc, extract, citation URL); getFact (search->title->summary, two keyless fetches, returns {fact:null,disambiguation?} so the caller asks-to-narrow vs falls-back-to-web_search). Wired get_fact tool + dispatch (disambiguation -> ask which; miss -> web_search) + BrowserBackend.getFact + defaultBackend + prompt menu + HELP + pinned tool-name list (41 tools). 13 new tests (url builders, search/summary parse incl disambiguation+clip, format, getFact resolve/miss/disambiguation/throw, 2 dispatch incl no-fabricate-on-ambiguous). suite 1790 green, tsc clean. Live-probed both Wikipedia APIs (search 200 resolves titles; summary 200 w/ extract+desc+url; disambiguation type detected) so call-tested:true for the sources; agent path offline-tested. Anvil-independent (keyless).

Extended silent-watch-death coverage to feed + watchlist alerts (softfail-missing-feed-watchlist). The failed-watch receipt only fires on softFail, which alert-runner set on the value/page/weather paths but NOT the feed-source or watchlist branches — so a persistently-dead RSS/Reddit/HN follow or an all-error stock basket looked armed forever with no receipt. feedSource branch: an empty result now flags softFail when the fetch THREW or the feed was already seeded (an empty pre-seed first check is just 'not ready', not dead). Watchlist branch: track anyReadable across members (a real non-error value = alive) and flag softFail when the no-change return had ZERO readable members (all null/degraded/error). The agent-driven feed + single-value degraded/error paths already flagged softFail upstream, unchanged. 7 new tests (feed: dead-seeded->softFail, empty-first-check->not, throw->softFail; watchlist: all-error->softFail, one-readable->healthy, unchanged->healthy). suite 1794 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Named-list CSV export (csv-export-tabular). Audit finding was partly stale — rowsToCsv was ALREADY wired to the compare tool (CSV_REQUEST_RE -> comparison.csv), and extract is inherently single-record-per-URL (extractFieldsResult coerces to one object) so an extract-CSV branch was dead code (built + reverted). The real remaining keepable-tabular gap was NAMED LISTS, read back only as bullets + lost on scroll. Added parseListExport ('export/download/send/save my <name> list [as csv/spreadsheet/file]', requires an export verb + a 'list' target so 'download my invoice'/'my grocery list' show don't hijack) + a listExport handler dep (returns the list's items) + handler routing BEFORE listCommand that builds a CSV via the existing rowsToCsv + sends it through sendDocument (falls back to bullet text on a channel w/o documents; empty/unknown list -> honest note). index wires listExport via lists.show. HELP line. 4 new tests (parseListExport parse/reject; handler sends grocery.csv; empty-list note no-doc). suite 1798 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Fixed a sticky nag silently retiring early when the hourly cap drops it (sticky-cap-drop-burns-budget). A sticky 'nag me every 15 min until done' is kind:interval (not graceEligible), so a busy/over-cap hour hit the drop branch which called safeComplete(s) with complete()'s default fired:true — incrementing stickyFired toward stickyMax for a ping that was NEVER sent, so a few capped hours silently exhausted the budget + dropped the meds/water safety-net with no message. Changed the over-cap drop to safeComplete(s,false) so only a CONFIRMED ping counts toward the anti-nag cap (mirrors the sticky-send-fail-burns-budget guard on the thrown-failure path). fired only gates the sticky increment; plain daily/weekly/interval still advance normally. 1 new test (over-cap sticky drop keeps stickyFired at 0, stays alive). suite 1799 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Stopped the destructive-action guard false-refusing benign browse clicks (dangerous-action-false-refuse). DANGEROUS_ACTION_RE matched bare ambiguous nouns (order|send|reset|remove|book|confirm|cancel) against label+selector, so legit navigation dead-ended a multi-step browse with a false REFUSED: 'Order status'/'Track order'/'My orders', 'Bookings'/'booking reference', 'reset filters', selectors like .remove-filter / #send-search. Split into two tiers in safety.ts: STRONG (unambiguous commit/destroy verbs — pay/delete/checkout/submit/unsubscribe/add to cart/'place order' — dangerous on their own) + CONTEXTUAL (ambiguous verb + a committing OBJECT — 'cancel my subscription', 'send money', 'remove payment card', 'reset password', 'factory reset', 'book now', 'confirm order/and pay' — but 'order status'/'reset filters'/'.remove-filter'/'#send-search' pass). isDangerousAction OR's both. All original m26 MUST_CATCH cases still flagged. 21 new tests (12 false-refuse-regression allows + 9 contextual catches). suite 1820 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent (the guard runs before any click).

Stopped a plain change-watch spamming overnight (unthrottled-change-watch). A no-threshold 'watch btc: price of bitcoin' is level-triggered (changed() true on any delta) and value alerts were EXEMPT from the quiet-hours defer (the classifier only marked feed/page persistent), so it pinged every cadence check all night. Reworked the quiet-deferrable classifier: extracted a pure isQuietDeferrable(alert) in alerts.ts — only a PREDICATE (below/above/in_stock) or WEATHER alert is edge-triggered (a crossing can revert overnight, must run on cadence -> not deferrable); everything else (plain/threshold change-watch, watchlist, feed, page-diff) has a PERSISTENT signal still there in the morning -> deferrable, so it batches to quiet-end instead of buzzing at 3am. index's alertQuietDeferrable now delegates to the pure helper (unknown -> not deferrable). The anti-spam hourly cap still exempts alert CHECKS (edge crossings mustn't be dropped) — this is only the quiet-hours SEND defer. 2 new tests (predicate/weather not deferrable; plain/threshold/watchlist/feed/page deferrable); existing runner persistent-defers + edge-exempt tests unchanged. suite 1822 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

A permanently-dead watchlist member now earns a receipt (watchlist-member-dead-no-receipt). A member whose source errors EVERY tick (bad ticker, dead link, login wall) was dropped via looksLikeErrorReply->continue before seeding, so it never alerted; the basket-level softFail can't fire because other readable members keep anyReadable true — the user believed all N items were tracked. alert-runner watchlist branch now collects the unreadable member LABELS (null/degraded/error) into a new deadMembers[] on AlertRunResult (returned on both the silent + notify exits; absent when all read fine). Threaded through index alertCheck -> runner, which streaks per-member in memberFailStreak keyed '<schedId>::<label>' and fires a one-time deadMemberNotice at FAIL_STREAK_NOTIFY (naming the dead member + how to fix/drop it), resetting a member's streak on any clean read. index wires deadMemberNotice. 5 new tests (checkAlert reports deadMembers / absent-when-healthy; runner: member dead 3 checks -> receipt, recovers -> resets no-repeat). suite 1825 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Good-deal price verdict on watch pings (good-deal-price-verdict). A change-watch ping showed just the new number; now once the watch has >=5 recorded points it appends where the value sits in its range — 'Lowest in ~30d — a good time if you're buying' / 'Highest — pricey right now' / near-low / near-high / middle(low..high) — turning a one-shot number into a judgment (the recurring 'what does Relay say' hook). New pure priceVerdict(points,current,minPoints=5) in alerts.ts (null under minPoints or on a flat range; direction-agnostic — a low frames as buy, a high as pricey, user decides). alert-runner change-watch notify appends it for a numeric watch via a new seriesOf dep (index wires alerts.seriesOf); prose/first-run/thin-history watches append nothing. 8 new tests (priceVerdict low/high/near-low/mid/flat/thin; checkAlert appends-verdict + none-when-thin). HELP updated. suite 1833 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent (reuses the recorded series).

Nutrition lookup (nutrition-lookup): 'calories in a banana' / 'protein in chicken breast' / 'carbs in a Big Mac' now answered from USDA FoodData Central instead of a web_search guess or invented figures. New src/lib/nutrition.ts: nutritionUrl (keyless USDA search, restricted to whole-food datasets Foundation/SR-Legacy/Survey so 'banana' isn't a random branded product; public DEMO_KEY, optional USDA_API_KEY for a real quota) + parseNutrition (top match -> per-100g kcal/protein/carb/fat; takes the KCAL energy row, NEVER lets a KJ value land in kcal; null when no macros) + formatNutrition (matched-food name so a mismatch is visible + a per-100g/source note) + getNutrition (null on miss/throw). Wired get_nutrition tool + dispatch (miss -> 'say not sure, don't invent') + BrowserBackend.getNutrition + defaultBackend + prompt menu + HELP + pinned tool-name list (42 tools) + USDA_API_KEY .env.example parity. 11 new tests (url, parse KCAL-vs-KJ/fallback/null, format, getNutrition resolve/throw/empty; 2 dispatch incl no-fabricate-on-miss). suite 1844 green, tsc clean. Live-probed USDA (200, banana/chicken/big-mac clean per-100g macros) so call-tested:true for the source; agent path offline-tested. Anvil-independent (keyless).

Where-to-watch (movie-where-to-watch): 'where can I watch Dune Part Two' / 'is Oppenheimer streaming' now returns a JustWatch per-region availability link instead of a cold logged-out scrape guessing a service. Probed the keyless options — TMDb/OMDb need a key (signup=owner-gated), iTunes movie search returns empty, JustWatch has no keyless API + needs anvil (down) — so, like the transit-directions bridge, built an HONEST link tool rather than inventing 'it's on Netflix'. New src/lib/watch-where.ts: parseWatchQuery (title out of 'where can I watch X'/'is X on Netflix', strips platform clause + 'the movie' filler, gated on a watch/stream cue) + justWatchUrl (per-region search URL, verified 200) + formatWatchWhere (link + a can't-confirm-a-service note). Wired a PURE where_to_watch tool (no backend) + dispatch (accepts a raw title or parses a verbatim sentence) + prompt menu + HELP + pinned tool-name list (43 tools). Tool desc steers rating/plot asks to get_fact. 5 new tests (parse extract/reject, url per-region, format honest-no-service; dispatch no-browser). suite 1849 green, tsc clean. Live-probed JustWatch search (200). Offline/anvil-independent (link-only, no fetch).

Fixed the flagship 'watch below X' silently degrading on the commonest phrasing (threshold-suffix-drop). The below/above/by operand regexes accepted only $?(digits with commas) anchored s*$ — so 'below 50k', 'above 1.2M', 'below 50,000 usd' matched NOTHING, leaving condition/threshold undefined and the alert falling through to a plain change-watch (fires on every wiggle, never the crossing; also the non-edge, non-quiet-deferrable kind that buzzes all day) — and the confirmation never revealed the threshold was dropped. extractValue already scaled k/m/bn on the VALUE side, so the parser was asymmetric. Extended the below/above/by grammar (parseAlertCommand AND parseAlertEdit) with an optional magnitude suffix (k/m/mm/mn/bn/b/t/thousand/…) + a trailing currency word (usd/eur/dollars/…), via a shared parseOperand(numStr,suffix) that strips commas + scales (magMult, allowBareMT since an explicit clause is unambiguous). 7 new assertions across parseAlertCommand + parseAlertEdit (50k/1.2m/50,000 usd/1.5bn/by 10k; edit 45k/1.2m). suite 1850 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Closed the inbound half of the failed-send gap (inbound-send-fail-swallowed). sendMessage returns a delivered-boolean the PROACTIVE runner gates on, but the inbound handler ignored it — a 429/network/blocked (or a failed chunk of a long) reply left the user with nothing/truncated AND still wrote the assistant turn to memory as delivered, so the next turn's context claimed an answer the user never saw. The text-reply path now captures the delivered result (=== false only, so a console channel returning void still counts delivered); on a failed send it skips the memory write entirely (leaves the user turn out too so a re-ask starts clean) + logs a send_failed_not_delivered miss + records a not-ok turn. Photo/doc paths unchanged. 3 new tests (failed send -> no memory + ok:false; success -> 2-msg memory; void channel -> delivered). suite 1853 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Fixed the flagship onboarding tap-to-try dead-end (onboarding-weather-deadend). The '☀️ Weather' first-win button ran a bare 'weather', which asks a cold user (no shared location) 'What city are you in?' — the one dead-end in an otherwise instant onboarding. Changed TRY_EXAMPLES weather entry to 'weather in New York' so the first tap always lands an answer; no example now depends on a saved location. 1 new guard test (no example is a bare weather/near-me location-relative errand). suite 1854 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent (all try examples are keyless).

Countdowns (countdown-tracker): 'countdown to my flight Dec 20' / 'countdown to vacation on 2026-07-01' now PERSIST as milestone reminders (a month/week out, day before, morning of) + confirm the day count, instead of date_math's one-shot answer — a sticky re-engagement hook. New src/lib/countdown.ts: parseCountdown (label + date via datecalc.parseDate incl holidays/ISO/M-D/'Dec 20', peels the trailing date phrase off the label, preferFuture rolls a bare month/day forward), countdownMilestones (future-only fire instants at 9am local, tz-shifted; near-term targets get only the applicable milestones), formatCountdown + milestonePing. Handler routes on the explicit 'countdown' word ONLY (a bare 'how many days until Christmas' stays a date_math QUESTION, not a scheduled countdown), BEFORE the schedule cue; index.countdownAdd synthesizes reminder-only clock-time onces via the existing ScheduleStore (no new runner) + returns the confirmation, past-date -> honest note. HELP line. 12 new tests (parse/milestone-future-filter/tz/format + handler route/past/not-a-countdown-question). suite 1866 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Personal quick-log tracker (quick-log-tracker) — the strongest daily-habit hook Relay lacked. 'log weight 182' / 'spent $14 on lunch' / 'log mood 7' append a tagged data point; 'show my weight this month' returns a summary + chart PNG, 'how much did I spend on food this week' returns a windowed total. New src/lib/logs.ts: LogStore (per-chat tag -> [{t,v}] + unit, atomic/corrupt-safe, caps 50 tags / 1000 pts oldest-drop, lastSaveOk), parseLogCommand ('log/track <tag> <value> [unit]' + money 'spent $X on <thing>' -> tag=thing unit=$), parseLogQuery (sum vs trend + today/week/month/year window; 'show my <tag>'/'how much did I spend on <tag>' — tightened so a bare 'what's the weather' isn't a log query), sumSeries. Wired logAdd + logQuery deps (index reuses summarizeSeries + renderChart via defaultFetchBytes) + state-paths RELAY_LOGS_FILE + .env parity + corrupt-store label. Handler routes log-ADD before the scheduler, log-QUERY gated on a show/how-much/trend cue + AFTER places/lists so 'show my grocery list' still lists. HELP line. 13 new tests (parse cmd/query, store append/per-chat/persist/unit, sumSeries windowed; handler log/sum/chart-photo/fallthrough). suite 1879 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent (quickchart render is the existing keyless path).

Person-anchored follow-up nudges (contact-followup-nudge). 'follow up with Sarah in 3 days' / 'remind me to reply to my landlord tomorrow' now schedule a reminder that, on fire, names the person AND (if saved) carries their email/phone + a one-tap mailto:/sms: draft link — a lightweight personal-CRM loop joining reminders + contacts + compose (all pre-existing; no new store/runner). New parseFollowUp in contacts.ts (splits contact name from the when clause; gated on a follow-up/get-back-to/reply-to verb). index.followUpAdd resolves the contact NOW + bakes handle+draft-link into a reminderOnly schedule via parseScheduleFor (reuses relative/on-Friday/next-week grammar). Handler routes on the follow-up verb before the generic schedule cue; an UNPARSED time falls through to the normal scheduler/agent (no dead-end). HELP line. 5 new tests (parseFollowUp split + reject; handler schedule/confirm, unparsed-fallthrough, non-followup-not-captured). suite 1884 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Extended the send-gated-commit invariant to the four INBOUND immediate-alert-check sites (immediate-alert-commit-not-send-gated). alert define, conversational edit, 'watch that', and the Refresh button each did 'await sendMessage(ping); commit()' unconditionally — but sendMessage returns false on a failed send (best-effort, doesn't throw), so a 429/network drop advanced the alert baseline anyway, eating the crossing (the watch looked armed but wouldn't re-fire until it crossed again). Now each message-path commit is gated on (await sendMessage(...)) !== false, mirroring the scheduler's already-correct gating; the silent path (no message) still commits (nothing to lose). 2 new tests (refresh send-fail -> no commit; define send-fail -> no commit). suite 1886 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Tap-to-install starter automations (starter-automation-gallery). The recurring-automation engine (recipes/digests/alerts) was under-adopted because activation needed 'save X:' syntax; the /templates catalog existed but was text-only (type '/templates <id>'). Added one-tap install BUTTONS: new 'install' callback op (in|<id>) + installButtons() in callbacks.ts, a short `button` label + templateButtons() on each Template, /templates now sends the catalog WITH a tap-install keyboard (channels w/o inline buttons keep the text list + /templates <id>), and handleCallback routes an install tap through the same recipeSaveNamed path (slot-template hint + 'schedule it every morning' nudge in the confirmation). Reuses the existing RecipeStore — no new store. HELP updated. 7 new tests (install codec + buttons round-trip, templateButtons pairs, handler install-tap saves + unknown-graceful, catalog copy). suite 1891 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Extended the send-gated-memory fix to the media reply paths (media-memory-not-send-gated). The text path already skipped the memory write on a failed send (inbound-send-fail-swallowed), but the four media branches — QR-scan reply, photo-to-action, photo describe, document describe — called memorySet unconditionally after the send, so a failed image/PDF answer was still recorded as delivered + the next message read as a follow-up to an unseen reply. Each now captures the sendMessage result + writes memory only when !== false (console channel returning void still counts delivered). 2 new tests (photo + doc answer whose send fails -> memory NOT written). suite 1893 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

A scheduled chained recipe that stops early is no longer pushed as a complete briefing (scheduled-chain-partial-unflagged). The scheduler's runChain dep returned Promise<string>, so a chain halted at an if-gate or a step that produced nothing was sent as normal complete-looking content every cadence, no '⚠️ partial' — while the inbound /run path already flagged stoppedEarly. Widened the runChain dep to return string | {final, stoppedEarly?, stepsDone?, stepsTotal?} (bare string still accepted = legacy complete); the runner sets res.degraded on stoppedEarly so the existing partial-banner + ok:!degraded metric fire. Reworded the banner cause-agnostic ('Partial — this didn't fully finish', not 'ran low on steps', since a chain stops for an if-gate too). index wires the structured result from runChain's ChainResult (final + stoppedEarly + step counts). 2 new tests (stopped-early -> banner + ok:false; completed structured -> no banner); existing legacy-string chain test unchanged. suite 1895 green, tsc clean. Offline; anvil-independent.

Digest whose sources ALL fail now returns a distinct {allFailed,note} outcome instead of a plain string; scheduler streaks it like a watch soft-fail (silent per fire, escalation receipt at N, gated on delivery) so a dead digest no longer pings the reassuring 'I'll try next run' note every morning with no escalation. /run + callback still show the note (user asked now). +2 tests, 1897 green.

changed() no longer fires on any nonzero delta for a no-threshold numeric watch; requires clearing a relative deadband (default 0.5%, env RELAY_ALERT_DEADBAND_PCT). Kills sub-cent price-jitter pings (alerts skip quiet hours + anti-spam cap); small-int counts + moves off zero still fire; explicit threshold + text-diff unchanged. +4 tests, 1901 green. .env.example parity added.

NO-CHANGE (already shipped): handleCommand (commands.ts:203) already maps a bare greeting/capability question -> START, and the handler (1587-96) already attaches try-buttons on a 👋 reply for a first-contact channel. Audit finding was stale; verified + closed.

Corrupt-store notice no longer lost if its send fails. corruptNotice() now PEEKS (no drain); handler gates a new corruptNoticeAck on delivery (send !== false), so a failed/thrown send re-surfaces the silent-wipe heads-up next inbound instead of swallowing the only signal that saved reminders/alerts/recipes were reset. index drains corruptedStores only in the ack. +1 test (failed-send re-surfaces), 1902 green.

A scheduled fire whose SEND outlives the 90s ceiling (long multi-chunk send) no longer double-pings. Added an in-flight `firing` guard (cleared on true settle via .finally on the raw fireOne promise) so an overlapping tick can't re-fire a once whose send is still landing, + a post-send isCancelled() re-check: on a delivered-after-timeout send, mark a once complete (delivered) so the catch's retry can't re-send, commit the alert baseline (crossing landed), and skip the double recordSend/complete. +1 test (send stalls past timeout, 2nd tick skips, one delivery). 1903 green.

Added truncateWindow (head+tail, drop middle) for PAGE content in formatPageForModel — a long article/listing/scoreboard's key fact (total/conclusion/score/stock status) sits at the END, which head-only truncateForModel dropped silently, so the agent answered confidently from the top slice with an authoritative Source line. Now keeps top + bottom (~35% tail) with a loud 'you see TOP and BOTTOM only, do NOT state as complete' marker. JSON/transcript/extract stay head-only (structure front-loaded). +5 tests, 1908 green.

extractValue was already hardened (currency-tag priority, %-exclusion, hint-proximity, entity-label exclusion) so the audit's own example (AAPL $230, up 2%, 50M -> 230) already worked. Sandbox-probing found the real residual: a HISTORICAL/comparison figure ('was $8', '$150 previously, now $120', '5 left, was 8') was tracked instead of the current value, so a 'below 130' watch on 'now $120, was $150' silently never fired. Added isHistoricalValue: drop candidates adjacent to from/previously/prior/earlier + 'was/were' (only when a current-value cue like now/currently/left/in stock is also present, so 'the rate was 1.085' still tracks 1.085) + trailing last-week/ago markers. Applied across currency/count-mag/untagged branches. +1 test, 1909 green.

Base city->tz inference was already built + fully wired (parseSetLocation/parseCityReply -> profile offset -> every schedule path). Sandbox-probing confirmed the real remaining wrong-hour bug was DST: CITY_TZ bakes STANDARD offsets so an inferred zone fired an hour off Mar-Nov (US/EU). Added CITY_ZONE (city->IANA) + offsetForZoneAt (DST-correct via Intl longOffset, full ICU) + inferTzFromLocation(loc, atMs) that computes the season-correct offset at set-time; parseSetLocation/parseCityReply take atMs (index passes Date.now()). Standard table stays the no-instant fallback. +4 tests, 1913 green.

A recurring daily/weekly/monthly/yearly now stores its IANA zone (inferred from the saved location) and recomputes the DST-correct offset at each occurrence via offsetForZoneAt, instead of freezing the offset stamped at creation. Before: a '7am daily' set in winter fired at 8am all summer (CST->CDT). Two-pass reschedule (provisional at frozen offset -> resolve zone offset there -> recompute once) since DST shifts are <=1h. restampTz stamps the zone too. Sandbox+unit verified: zone-stamped daily holds 7am local across the boundary, no-zone control drifts to 8am. +4 tests, 1917 green.

NO-CHANGE (already shipped): one-tap request_location button is wired end-to-end (telegram sendLocationRequest -> channel.requestLocation -> index -> handler L884 on a first location errand, plain-text fallback). Stale audit finding, verified + closed.

get_time/runWorldClock now DST-correct: a city/region resolves via its IANA zone (offsetForZoneAt) at the query instant, so 'time in London' in July is BST not GMT; a typed abbreviation (PST/EST) is honored as-is; the always-on 'may be an hour off' disclaimer now shows only for standard-only offsets. Reuses the CITY_ZONE infra from the reminder-DST fix. Tool descriptions updated. +5 tests, 1922 green.

Swept the tz-derived tools for the DST gap. suntimes.ts (Open-Meteo timezone=auto, local ISO) + datecalc.ts (UTC-anchored day math, injected today) are DST-safe. Found + fixed the real one: the agent's live 'current time'/'today' line used the FROZEN profile tzOffsetMin (chatTzOffsetMin + agentEnvFor), so after a DST boundary it ran an hour off + wrong calendar day near midnight (current-datetime-dst-stale). Added ProfileStore.offsetMinAt(chatId, atMs): resolves the saved location's IANA zone -> DST-correct offset at now, frozen offset as fallback. Both live-datetime sites now use it. +1 test, 1923 green.

NEW FEATURE: 'save this <link>' scrapes+summarizes the page (via runAgent) + stores {url,title,summary,t} in a new SavedStore (mirrors NotesStore: atomic/corrupt-safe, per-chat cap 100, url de-dupe, lastSaveOk hedge). Recall via 'what did I save about X' / 'my reading list' / 'search my saved for X' — full-text whole-word scoring (title weighted 2x), no agent run. Handler routes recall-before-save; save gated on a save/bookmark/read-later verb + a URL so 'read this link' still fetches-now. New src/lib/readlater.ts, RELAY_SAVED_FILE path, HELP line. +12 tests (readlater unit + handler routing), 1935 green. Live summarize path needs anvil (DOWN) — store+parse+routing unit-verified offline with a mock summarizer.

Added a save_page(url,title?,summary?) agent tool so the agent can file a page it JUST found into the user's read-it-later list — 'find a good pasta recipe and save it' now completes in one turn. Full tool-add: TOOLS[] entry + AgentEnv.savePage dep (chat-bound in agentEnvFor, writes to the same SavedStore as the command path) + dispatch case (rejects a non-http(s) URL so no junk/search-results get saved) + prompt-menu line + sorted dispatch-test list. +2 tests (saves url/title/summary no-browser; rejects non-URL), 1937 green.

A reserved digest member ('reading list'/'saved'/'reading recap'/'read later') now folds a recap of recent read-it-later saves into a briefing — 'define digest morning: weather, reading list'. digest-runner intercepts the recap member BEFORE resolveRecipe (new savedRecap dep, pure store read, no agent/anvil); nothing-saved reads as an empty 'gone' member so a digest of only an empty reading list stays silent like an all-deleted one. New readingRecap + isReadingRecapMember in readlater.ts; index wires savedRecap: readingRecap(saved.list). HELP updated. +6 tests, 1943 green.

Saved pages now track lastRecalledAt (stamped whenever a page appears in a recall or the digest recap), and SavedStore.unread(staleMs) returns saved-before-cutoff + never/long-ago-revisited pages oldest-first. 'what haven't I read' / 'what did I save and forget' (isUnreadSavedRequest, checked before general recall) replies with formatUnreadNudge and marks them seen. RELAY_SAVED_STALE_MS (default 7d) tunes the cutoff. Closes the leak where a saved-and-forgotten page never got a second nudge. +5 tests, 1948 green.

Opt-in weekly proactive reading-list nudge. 'nudge me about my reading list' adds a WEEKLY 'unread:reading-list' schedule (Mon 9am, one per chat, removeByTask-first so re-opt-in doesn't stack); 'stop reading list nudges' removes it (parseUnreadNudgeToggle, handler-routed before recall so it isn't shadowed). Scheduler fires it via a new unreadNudge dep — pure store read, null = nothing stale this week -> silent + reschedule (like an unchanged alert), never a failure; a message gets the same delivery-gated send/complete as any proactive. As kind:weekly it already inherits quiet-hours defer + anti-spam grace. Nudged pages are markRecalled so they don't re-surface next week. +4 tests, 1952 green. Live proactive fire needs the running bot (offline) — fire branch + toggle + store all unit-verified.

Self-audit (agent spawn cap exhausted, no 3-agent AUDIT): probed calc/units-convert/unitprice/compose. calc + units-convert + compose all correct. Found unitprice dead-ended on the connector-less '12 rolls $6 vs 8 rolls $4.50' shelf phrasing (parseOption Form A needed for/at/@) -> fell to the agent's forbidden mental math. Added Form A2 ('<qty><unit> $<price>', $-required so bare '12 rolls 6' stays ambiguous). +3 tests, 1955 green.

Self-audit (agent cap exhausted): probed recipes (chain/slot logic ok, one low papercut noted) + alert parsing. Found parseAlertCommand split name:task on the first colon, so 'watch this page https://ex.com for changes' made a garbage alert ('this page https' / '//ex.com ...'). Added (?!//) to the separator so a URL-scheme colon isn't a boundary; genuine 'name: <url>' still splits. +1 test, 1956 green.

Self-audit (agent cap exhausted) swept chain-runner (containsUnnegated ok), telegram parseUpdates (ok), last-result chunkFrom/extractLinks (ok), safety.ts. Found the dangerous-action guard let 'Send $50 to John' / 'transfer £200' / 'pay 100 usd' / 'Venmo $20' + 'empty trash' / 'clear cart' through — a SAFETY false-negative (agent could autonomously click a real payment/destroy). Added money-amount + empty/clear-container branches to CONTEXTUAL_RE; no overblock of send-search/email/link, clear-filters, empty-state. +2 tests, 1958 green.

Adversarial-probed the dangerous-action guard: ~34 real commit/destroy button labels slipped through. Added catches for apply/enroll/register/reserve/rent + now/for (application/enrollment commits, not 'apply filter'/'register to read'), accept|agree + offer/terms/continue (not 'accept cookies'), remove|delete all/everything, block/report/flag a user/post + 'report as spam', cash out, post/publish/leave/submit + comment/review, sign|downgrade|upgrade + a commit object (plan/contract/lease/membership added to COMMIT_OBJ), + publish/unfriend/unfollow as strong verbs. Re-verified no overblock (sign in, apply filter/coupon, accept cookies, register to read, design plan, assign a task, vote count, report card, update profile). +36 adversarial test cases, 1995 green.

Traced the click/type dispatch (agent.ts:964-983): isDangerousAction(label+selector) at L972 refuses + continues BEFORE backend.click/type at L977-978 — the guard IS wired. Added 3 integration tests via the recording backend: 'click Pay now' -> refused (backend.click never runs) + agent replies it can't; 'click Read more' -> click:.read-more DOES reach the backend (no over-block); a danger named only in the SELECTOR (#delete-account-btn, no label) -> also refused (guard sees label+selector). Proves the hardened regex is enforced at runtime, not just unit-tested — a wiring regression now fails a test. +3 tests, 1998 green.

Swept every per-chat store for silent data loss. NotesStore (evicted[] returned + handler warns), SavedStore (evicted[] + oldest-drop, lastSaveOk hedge), Contacts/Places/new-List cap (return null -> handler says 'hit the limit'), all persist paths (lastSaveOk hedges) — CLEAN. Found ONE real silent loss: ListStore.add dropped items over MAX_ITEMS_PER_LIST (100) via a bare `continue`, indistinguishable from a dedupe, so the handler said 'Added N' / 'Already on your list' while quietly losing the rest (lists-cap-silent-drop). Now returns `capped[]`; the handler tells the user which items didn't fit + that the list is full. +4 tests (store capped/dedupe-distinct + unit), 2000 green.

Swept the automation-builder member caps for the silent-drop class (after the lists fix). Digest members over maxMembers + watchlist sub-watches over MAX_WATCHLIST_MEMBERS (8) were both sliced silently — a user defining a big digest/watchlist lost the tail with no notice. DigestStore.add now records the dropped members (lastDroppedForCap(), like lastSaveOk); parseAlertCommand sets droppedMembers on ParsedAlert. Both handlers name what didn't fit ('kept the first N, left out X'). Chain-step cap (6) has the same silent slice but is lower-frequency -> seeded as a follow-on. +2 tests, 2000 green.

Self-audit (agent cap 200/200): verified scheduler recurrence math (nextWeekly/Monthly/Yearly roll-forward, month-end clamp, leap, multi-day ordering, DST-offset) all CORRECT. Probed feed-source resolution: 'follow news.ycombinator.com' fell to the bare-URL RSS branch + dead-parsed HN's HTML homepage -> a silently-dead follow. Mapped the HN host to the Algolia front-page feed (tightened so blog.ycombinator.com/feed.xml + /item permalinks stay real RSS). +1 test, 2001 green.

Probed resolveFeedSource on the URLs users actually paste. Found more dead-parse follows (returned rss but the URL has no feed -> silently never fires): youtube @handle//c//user/ + youtu.be video, reddit user page, github repo. Fixed: GitHub owner/repo -> releases.atom (keyless, new capability, blocklists settings/marketplace/etc), Reddit user -> user/.rss (keyless), and YouTube non-channel-id URLs -> null (need a handle->id lookup, so fall back to the agent feed-watch instead of a dead RSS parse). +3 tests, 2004 green.

HELP + START now enumerate the followable sources so users discover them: subreddit, Reddit user, HN (+topic), GitHub repo releases, any RSS/blog, and a YouTube channel (with the caveat that an @handle link needs the channel URL). Surfaces the GitHub-releases + Reddit-user follows just added. Copy-only; 2004 green.

Self-audit (agent cap 200/200): probed countdown + milestone math. Milestones (future-only, tz-shift, day-of) correct. Found parseCountdown labeled a bare-holiday countdown 'it' ('days until Christmas' -> label empty -> 'it') because the holiday was consumed as the date phrase. Now a named (alphabetic) date phrase doubles as the label when nothing else was given; numeric/ISO still -> 'it'. +1 test, 2005 green.

Chain recipe saved with >6 steps silently kept only the first 6 (parseChainSteps slice). Added chainOverflow(task) (pure, no change to parseChainSteps's shape so its many callers are untouched); recipeSave + recipeSaveNamed return droppedSteps, and both save confirmations tell the user 'a chain runs up to 6 steps, so I dropped the last N'. Completes the cap-drop trust class (lists, digests, watchlists, now chains). +1 test, 2006 green.

Self-audit (agent cap 200/200): probed 3 fresh surfaces first — answer-log recall matching (precise, clean), cookie-jar host-scoping (sound: subdomain match, no suffix-confusion leak), earlier recurrence/countdown-milestones (clean) — CONVERGENCE confirmed on reliability veins. Then cleared the single-slot papercut: '/run greet name=Sam' on 'hi {name}' yielded 'hi name=Sam'; now a 'slot=value' arg naming THAT slot fills just the value (bare value still works, non-matching pair stays literal, value-with-= preserved, multi-slot unaffected). +1 test, 2007 green.

Agent save_page now distinguishes add vs update: SavedStore.add already returned dup (URL re-save updates in place), but the AgentEnv savePage result dropped it, so the agent always said 'Saved' even for a re-save. Threaded dup through the AgentEnv return + index wiring + the dispatch push, so the tool result says 'Updated "X" (already in the reading list — refreshed it)' on a dup — matching the command path's Updated/Saved. +1 test, 2008 green.

Unit-price 3-way compares read right now. The math was already correct (cheapest ✅) but: a 3+ option compare dropped the '% cheaper' entirely (only 2-way computed it), and a dead tie said '(0% cheaper)' + ✅-picked an arbitrary winner. Now: savings computed vs the RUNNER-UP ('X% cheaper than the next-best' for 3+, plain 'X% cheaper' for 2), and an all-equal tie says 'Same price either way — $Y per unit' with NO checkmark. +3 tests, 2011 green.

Terminal Stop tap now retires the tapped ping's inline buttons in place instead of leaving a dead card that can be re-tapped. Added editMessageReplyMarkup to telegram.ts + Channel.editReplyMarkup + handler dep; threaded the tapped messageId through handleCallback; on a successful alertForget, strip the buttons via editReplyMarkup(chatId, messageId). Best-effort + gated on a REAL stop (a no-op forget leaves buttons). Scoped to the terminal action (full every-reply-in-place edit was heavier than the low warranted). +2 tests, 2013 green.

Extended the retire-buttons-in-place fix beyond Stop: a Snooze tap now strips the tapped ping's buttons (a Refresh would defeat the snooze the user just set; reply says how to resume), and a Run-again tap on a GONE digest/recipe (null result) strips its stale button so a re-tap can't keep hitting a dead automation.
